proposals.evidence: Turner 6141 gives the old dā- and productive dē- “give” verb family, including Bashkarik da- and nearby Kohistani/Shina forms. Buddruss Grangali da- is the bare “give” stem. This attaches the broad verbal article without asserting an inflectional subdivision. Exact manually collated source key and original hyphenated stem checked; no import or transcription change.
